requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that response times for user interactions are within 5 seconds.
requirements.source_citation: maybe around five seconds for the small transitions? Less is better, but once you start waiting longer than that it becomes noticeable.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions a performance expectation of around five seconds for transitions, indicating a clear requirement for response time.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific user interactions are considered 'small transitions' and do they all have the same performance expectations?

requirements.requirement: The system shall support at least 350 concurrent active users during peak usage times.
requirements.source_citation: I believe our planning number is three hundred and fifty concurrent active users at peak
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder provides a specific number for concurrent users, indicating a clear scalability requirement.
requirements.follow_up_question: Are there any specific times or events that typically cause peak usage, and how does the system need to handle usage beyond 350 concurrent users?

requirements.requirement: The system shall implement role-based access control to ensure users can only perform actions and view data appropriate to their job roles and assigned accounts.
requirements.source_citation: Only certain reps should be able to open a dispute or ask for an adjustment. Some people should only be able to view, and others need full powers. It's sensitive — you don't want front-line staff adjusting accounts casually. We also have to make sure reps can't see cases for cardmembers they don't cover; that's caused problems before.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions the need for role-based access control and data segregation based on job roles and assigned accounts.
requirements.follow_up_question: Can you provide specific job roles and their corresponding access levels and permissions?

requirements.requirement: The system shall maintain a comprehensive audit log of all user actions, including who performed the action and when.
requirements.source_citation: Every action a user takes — opening the case, editing notes, sending a letter, requesting an adjustment — we need to know who did what and when.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for a comprehensive audit log to track all user actions.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific user actions need to be logged, and are there any additional details that need to be captured in the audit log?

requirements.requirement: The system shall be available during all business hours and support planned early-morning maintenance windows.
requirements.source_citation: It needs to be available basically whenever reps are working and also for some external users. We can't have it down during the day. We tolerate some planned early-morning maintenance, but otherwise it should be up most of the time.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specifies the need for high availability during business hours and mentions planned maintenance windows.
requirements.follow_up_question: Can you provide the exact times for the planned early-morning maintenance windows?

requirements.requirement: The system shall integrate with existing backend systems for transaction data, cardmember details, and account adjustments.
requirements.source_citation: It should talk to the places that are the masters for data. So the transaction store for statements, the member information store for cardmember details, and the posting/billing system for adjustments. I want the disputes tool to orchestrate these calls so reps don't have to.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions the need for integration with specific backend systems for data and operations.
requirements.follow_up_question: Can you provide the exact list of backend systems and their owners for coordination purposes?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that the user interface is consistent with corporate UI standards.
requirements.source_citation: the look and feel should align with our corporate UI so external users feel it's the same brand when we expose parts of this to merchants or partners. It's jarring when internal tools look different from customer-facing apps.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder emphasizes the need for a consistent UI that aligns with corporate standards to avoid jarring differences.
requirements.follow_up_question: Are there specific corporate UI standards or guidelines that the system needs to follow?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that external users can only see their own data and cannot access data belonging to other users.
requirements.source_citation: The external view shouldn't expose internal-only data, and it should be simpler. Oh, and we need strong separation so one merchant can't see another merchant's disputes. Same for reps and their cardholder bases.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentions the need for strong data segregation to ensure external users can only see their own data.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific measures should be implemented to ensure data segregation for external users?

requirements.requirement: The system shall provide a unified interface to minimize the need for users to switch between different systems.
requirements.source_citation: having to hop into ten other systems is a nightmare. So, yeah, create, follow-up, and track everything, and make it feel like one place.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder emphasizes the need for a unified interface to reduce the frustration of switching between multiple systems.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific functionalities should be included in the unified interface to minimize system switching?

requirements.requirement: The system shall provide templates for common correspondence to save time for users.
requirements.source_citation: having templates for common correspondence is a big time-saver.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need for templates to save time, indicating a usability requirement.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific types of correspondence templates should be provided?

requirements.requirement: The system shall implement checks and balances for actions with financial impact, such as mandatory supervisor approval.
requirements.source_citation: checks and balances for actions that have financial impact, like a mandatory supervisor approval popup or something, would help avoid mistakes.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need for checks and balances, such as supervisor approval, for actions with financial impact.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific actions with financial impact require mandatory supervisor approval?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that all transaction data comes from the authoritative source to avoid stale or incorrect data.
requirements.source_citation: It has to come from the authoritative source — our transaction store. We can't have reps looking at stale copies or someone pasting in numbers.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for data to come from the authoritative source to avoid stale or incorrect data.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific measures should be implemented to ensure data comes from the authoritative source?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that cardmember details are consistent and come from the single source for member details.
requirements.source_citation: Cardmember info should come from the system that is the single source for member details. We have to be consistent with names, addresses, contact preferences, that sort of thing.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder emphasizes the need for consistent cardmember details from a single source.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific cardmember details need to be consistent and come from the single source?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that all correspondence sent by reps is recorded and provable.
requirements.source_citation: It's embarrassing when a rep says they mailed something but we can't prove it later.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need to record and prove correspondence sent by reps.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific types of correspondence need to be recorded and provable?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that account adjustments are handled by the billing/posting system to maintain a clean and auditable ledger.
requirements.source_citation: They should go to the system that actually posts things to accounts. We can't have the disputes tool directly changing balances; it should hand off a request to the billing/posting system and then record the outcome.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for account adjustments to be handled by the billing/posting system to maintain auditability.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific measures should be implemented to ensure account adjustments are handled by the billing/posting system?

requirements.requirement: The system shall provide dashboards for managers to monitor queue health, aging disputes, and user workloads.
requirements.source_citation: Managers want dashboards for queue health and aging disputes and to see who is overloaded.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need for dashboards to monitor queue health, aging disputes, and user workloads.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics should be included in the dashboards for managers?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that maintenance windows are communicated well to avoid unplanned downtime during business hours.
requirements.source_citation: sometimes maintenance knocks people out during business hours because windows weren't communicated well.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need to communicate maintenance windows well to avoid unplanned downtime.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific measures should be implemented to ensure maintenance windows are communicated effectively?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that all user actions with financial impact are auditable and reversible.
requirements.source_citation: We had an incident where a rep adjusted an account in error because they thought a field was editable; the audit trail was incomplete and it took days to sort out.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need for a complete audit trail to handle incidents involving financial impact.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific measures should be implemented to ensure all user actions with financial impact are auditable and reversible?

requirements.requirement: The system shall ensure that transaction timestamps are consistent across all systems.
requirements.source_citation: two systems had different transaction timestamps and nobody knew which was right.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need for consistent transaction timestamps across all systems.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific measures should be implemented to ensure transaction timestamps are consistent across all systems?
